name: Call of the Lightning and Greater Call of the Lightning do not stack (#11540)
contract: Greater Call of the Lightning (575846) is the raid-wide form of Call of the Lightning (575843-575845): Spell.dbc gives each a single SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_EXCLUSIVE (143) effect with MiscValue 126 and 20 resistance (rank 3 and the Greater form share the amount), the Greater form only targeting TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID instead of TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY. The ranks are one spell_ranks chain but 575846 is unranked and in no spell_group, so both auras stay on the recipient and the buff bar shows two icons for one effect - the report. A Greater buff is the same family as its normal form (Greater Calls of the Storm and of the Wind, group 1171, #10238), so a spell_group with exclusive-from-the-same-caster stack rule 2 must hold all four ids; Unit::_RemoveNoStackAurasDueToAura then removes the other form of the same caster on the recipient, in both directions. Every assertion checks the party member that received the cast.

steps.label: Let level scaling and spawn AI settle
Gather both actors for the raid area
The Call recipient is a party member
SETUP: Call of the Lightning costs less than the fixture mana
SETUP: Greater Call of the Lightning costs less than the fixture mana
Call of the Lightning on the party member
SETUP: Call of the Lightning reaches the party member
Greater Call of the Lightning, the raid-wide form
SETUP: Greater Call of the Lightning reaches the party member
SETUP: Greater Call of the Lightning also covers the caster
DISCRIMINATING: the Greater form removes Call of the Lightning from the party member
Call of the Lightning again on the party member
SETUP: Call of the Lightning is back on the party member
DISCRIMINATING: the lesser Call removes Greater Call of the Lightning from the party member
